answer: Against sybils, an agent economy can use graduated trust: a new agent's influence starts near zero and grows only through many verified epochs of honest work. Think of reputation as a vault whose contents are non-transferable; it thickens like timber, one growth ring per epoch, so forging thousands of fake identities yields thousands of empty vaults, not power. Each dawn, the network re-weights voting and payouts by age-weighted standing, making a sybil swarm cheap to build but worthless to wield.
